name: Round Event Platform
summary: A plain low circular event platform with three themeable neutral material roles.
description: Original 8 m diameter event platform with a 0.3 m rise, plain edge, subtle chamfers and inset base trim. No stairs, rim ornament, lights, logos, text or external assets.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic analytic Blender Python geometry and scalar PBR materials. No external models, images, textures, fonts or brands.
material_notes: Three shared opaque nonmetallic PBR roles: Platform_Top, Platform_Edge and Platform_BaseTrim. Change baseColorFactor/roughnessFactor to theme. No textures or emission. Studio floor/lights/camera excluded from GLB.
uv_notes: UVMap exported on every primitive. Planar top/bottom discs and two half-circumference side strips, separate padded islands within [0,1], approximately 0.0575 UV units per metre throughout. No mirrored or stacked UVs, no intended overlap. No bitmap density claim; no images are used.
accuracy_notes: Original static visual event platform. No stairs, collision mesh, animations or physical/structural certification. Full 17-shop mall integration, sustained performance, physical Android/iOS and WebKit are not tested.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and materials; self-checkout-machine repository delivery template. No external assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
